result.title: A Daily Walking Program and Glycemic Control in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes: A Randomized Trial.
result.authorString: Delgado M, Osei K, Park H, Romero L.
result.abstractText:
Background

Walking is widely recommended.

Results

HbA1c fell by 0.6 percentage points in the walking group compared with 0.1 in usual care (difference 0.5; 95% CI 0.3–0.7).

result.title: Steps per Day and Long-Term HbA1c in a Primary Care Cohort.
result.authorString: Chen S, Bello A, Lindqvist R.
result.abstractText: Each additional 1,000 daily steps was associated with an HbA1c 0.08 percentage points lower (95% CI 0.05 to 0.11).

result.title: Physical Activity Programs for Adults With Diabetes: A Fictional Evidence Review
result.abstractText: Structured, supervised programs improved glycemic control more than advice alone.
